taskBookCapability: Requires permission to create a lab book in the chosen project. Uses the standard lab book tools.
taskRecordCapability: Requires permission to write in the chosen lab book. Uses the standard record editor.
taskKeyboard: Use Tab to move between fields, Space to toggle sections and Enter to continue.
taskSearch: Find a starter by task or output
taskCopyPolicy: The structure is copied. Future updates leave your work intact. No examples are added.
taskBookCopy: Creates one empty lab book with the entry types you select. You choose access in the next step.
taskRecordCopy: Starts one private entry in the selected lab book. You can edit every heading.
taskNeedsProject: Choose or create a project to add a lab book.
taskNeedsBook: Choose or create a lab book to start an entry.
task_blankRecord_help: Start with a title and an empty writing area.
task_blankBook_help: Create an empty book with no predefined entry types.
task_projectDiary_help: Record work, decisions and next steps.
task_illustratedProcedure_help: Write ordered instructions, add your own illustrations and describe how to check the result.
task_fieldVisit_help: Document the conditions, observations and evidence from a visit.
task_lesson_help: Plan one lesson, its learning activity and reflection.
task_studioSession_help: Describe the recording setup, takes and decisions for a session.
task_hiveInspection_help: Identify the hive and distinguish observations from actions and follow-up.
task_methodsBook_help: Keep methods and results as separate entry types in one lab book.
description: Prepare reusable instructions for experiments, protocols or other records. Release a reviewed version before using it. Each new record is independent.
sourceHelp: Choose the sections to include in your template. Include just their headings, or also copy their instructions. The saved source version stays fixed while you choose; results and evidence are not copied automatically.
sourceEmpty: This record has no writing sections.
sourceIncomplete: The source response was incomplete. Your choices are retained; try again.
reopen: The workspace changed. Reopen the template library.
name: Template name
title: Title for new records
invalid: Check the template fields. Instructions can contain formatting, tables, equations and external citations. Workspace links, placed figures and custom fonts require replacing or removing before this template can be reused independently.
archiveHelp: Archived templates retain their history and existing records. Restore this template before starting another record from it.
releaseHelp: Review the draft's instructions before releasing. This exact version is retained permanently; later edits create a separate draft.
noRelease: This template has no released version yet.
book: Lab book for the new record
useHelp: The new record starts privately in Draft with an unknown date. Attachments, figures, execution events, assessments, contributors and completed outcomes are not copied.
created: A private draft record was created.
exportHelp: This package contains the reviewed instructions, release note and version fingerprint. Share its password separately. The recipient imports an independent draft; this is not a signed identity claim.
importHelp: The reviewed instructions will become a new draft. Review and release it locally before use. No records, evidence, workspace identities or permissions are imported.
captureHelp: Choose exactly which instruction bodies to copy. All section titles are included, with unchecked bodies blank. Review the draft before releasing it. Results, evidence, relationships and structured execution data are never copied automatically.
noOrigin: This record was not created from a released record template.
originHelp: This is the immutable template version used when this record was created. Editing the template does not change the record.
discardedResults: Review selected text to remove record-specific results before releasing.
notebookMissing: Choose a lab book before creating a record.
pagedEditHelp: Edit the details or choose a section.
pagedReadHelp: Open the starting instructions or a section to read this saved version.
changed: This template changed in another window. Return to the template and reopen it before selecting instructions.
newHelp: Save this draft, then edit its sections or add more from the template editor.
importRecovered: This package was already imported. Its saved template is open.
